title: Postinstall hook climbs one directory and appends a loader to every sibling package
intent: Model local propagation that never names node_modules or a parent-escape literal: a root-level install script takes path.dirname(__dirname), which is the directory its dependencies are unpacked into, and walks it. Inert fixture; the target is a fixture path, not a real tree. The source never names the install root, so co-occurrence scoring misses it; reported as a frontier case for propagation.package-mutation.
